name: Pembrolizumab + Chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-355 metastatic TNBC)
cyclesNote: Cycled every 21 days until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity (up to 24 months / 35 cycles for pembrolizumab). Chemotherapy partner schedule depends on agent selected.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.primaryStudy: KEYNOTE-355: Cortes J, Cescon DW, Rugo HS, et al. Lancet 2020;396:1817-1828; N Engl J Med 2022;387:217-226
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-Q 3, 14 of 15)

biomarkers.note: Requires locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic TNBC (ER-negative, PR-negative, HER2-negative) with PD-L1 expression combined positive score (CPS) ≥10 using the 22C3 pharmDx assay. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-Q (3 of 15 and 14 of 15) (Category 1, Preferred).

premedications.name: Taxane premedication (if paclitaxel partner)
premedications.notes: Dexamethasone 20 mg PO ~12h and 6h prior, plus diphenhydramine 50 mg IV and famotidine 20 mg IV 30-60 min prior to paclitaxel.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Moderate emetic risk for carboplatin/gemcitabine partner; low emetic risk for single-agent taxane partner.

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event (irAE) monitoring: screen for pneumonitis, colitis, hepatitis, endocrinopathies (hypo/hyperthyroidism, hypophysitis, adrenal insufficiency), nephritis, and severe skin reactions.

Steroid guidance for irAE: withhold pembrolizumab for Grade 2 irAEs; initiate systemic corticosteroids (prednisone 1-2 mg/kg/day equivalent) for Grade ≥2 irAEs. Permanently discontinue for Grade 3-4 irAEs (except manageable endocrinopathies).
Taxane neuropathy: assess peripheral neuropathy before each cycle.
monitoring: Thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) at baseline, every 3-6 weeks during treatment, and as clinically indicated
Liver function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin) and renal function tests before each cycle
CBC with differential before each cycle
Monitor for pulmonary symptoms (cough, shortness of breath) and gastrointestinal symptoms (diarrhea, abdominal pain)
clearanceChecks: liver function tests (ALT/AST ≤ 2.5x ULN or ≤ 5x ULN if liver metastases)

doseModificationRules.text: Withhold pembrolizumab. Administer systemic corticosteroids (1 to 2 mg/kg/day prednisone equivalent) followed by taper. Resume when recovered to grade ≤ 1 after steroid taper. Discontinue permanently for Grade 3 or 4 pneumonitis.
Withhold pembrolizumab for Grade 2 or 3; initiate systemic corticosteroids. Resume if improves to Grade ≤ 1. Permanently discontinue for Grade 4 colitis or recurrence.
Hold chemotherapy partner until ANC ≥ 1000/mcL and platelets ≥ 75,000/mcL. Dose reduce chemotherapy partner per package insert.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV Day 1 every 21 days (or 400 mg IV every 42 days), in combination with chemotherapy partner.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Preferred taxane partner: PACLitaxel 90 mg/m2 IV on Days 1, 8, and 15 every 28 days (or nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m2 d1, 8, 15 q28d; or gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 + carboplatin AUC 2 d1, 8 q21d per KEYNOTE-355).
